title: Pan-Seared Irish Pork Belly
description: A delicious and crispy pan-seared pork belly dish, inspired by Irish cuisine.
instructions: Season the pork belly with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork belly for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Remove the skillet from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the pork belly into thick slices.
Serve with garlic and thyme, if desired.
